outlook.statement: During the year under review, the gross income has decreased from Rs. 1027.59 lakhs to Rs.751.92 lakhs from the previous year registering decrease of 26.83% in revenue. The Company has incurred loss of Rs. 14.49 lakhs during the year against profit of Rs. 20.05 lakhs in the previous year.

The Company is highly competitive in selection of raw material from high quality limestone. The Company gives importance to satisfaction of customers and their support in the long term. There are inherent opportunities available to the Company to which it is catering for many decades such as personal care products, rubber & plastics, paint and other value added products and optimistic to achieve good results.

risks: At present the Company has not identified any element of risk which may threaten the existence of the Company.
unfavourable limestone mining and stringent regulations
limestone reserves concentrated in few places and situated far from production facilities
import of good quality limestone contributes to higher production cost
competition from other big players and unorganized players in calcium carbonate industry
litigations including civil cases, excise and customs related cases
